answer: An incident to design against. A jury drew three members from one subnet and cleared 200 claims in a single epoch. The fix is a rule that juries span three subnetworks, and one upheld challenge revokes the whole batch. Duplicates are caught by replay, matching revealed text against the ledger, so renaming changes nothing. The umber mark on a revoked batch stays visible. Each revoked claim returns the bond to escrow and the identity to the nadir of its score. The plume of a bad batch is long, and that is the deterrent.
